name: Quan Chen
intro: I am an undergraduate at Peking University, studying Mathematics at the School of Mathematical Sciences and pursuing a double degree in Computer Science.
My research interests include trustworthy large language models and reasoning in large language models.
I keep course notes, small projects, and things I learn along the way on my blog. Outside of studying, I enjoy listening to JJ Lin.
